The following events took place in approximately '''7811 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*The [[Waymancy Storm]] occurs&mdash;a conflict between the Galactic Republic and the [[Signatories of Waymancy]]. The victorious Republic reverse-engineered the [[Sisters of the Machinesmith]]'s power generator technology to develop far more powerful turbolaser weaponry.<ref name="Warfare" />
